string.text:
A battered sheet covered with notes about hidden records from the city. It can mark a stash containing an unread document on the map.

It first looks for a note that has already been placed in a stash but not yet collected. If none is available, it points to an unsearched stash that can supply one of the missing notes.

New lead: 70% green stash, 20% cyan, 10% purple.

Once all 80 collectible notes have been recovered, the sheet begins tracking the next main-story document instead. Story leads progress from cyan stashes to purple and legendary ones; documents 11 and 12 remain exclusive to cyan stashes.

Each sheet provides one new lead. If no suitable note is available, or its lead has already been revealed, the sheet is not consumed.
This stash contains a document I have not found yet. Coordinates added to the map: %s. X: %.0f, Z: %.0f.
I already have this lead. I should collect the document first: %s. X: %.0f, Z: %.0f. The sheet was not consumed.
There is currently no suitable stash containing an undiscovered collectible or story document. The sheet was not consumed.
I could not narrow down the lead yet. I should check these coordinates again later. The sheet was not consumed.
These coordinates can only be checked in Greater Pripyat. The sheet was not consumed.
